description: Design and build richly detailed, explorable Three.js worlds.
longDescription: Turn a short description of a place into a written world design, realize it as a walkable Three.js scene with a themed presentation layer, and inspect the rendered result until it matches the design.
example.1: Build an explorable 3D world from this scene idea.
example.2: Add a new region to the current Three.js world.
example.3: Review the current world against its design and fix what looks weak.
